name: Pißwasser
summary: Satirical German export lager celebrated for excessive alcohol content and ridiculously patriotic marketing. Available at bars and convenience stores statewide.
description: Pißwasser ('You're in for a good time!') remains the Grand Theft Auto series' preeminent satirical beer brand. In GTA VI, neon Pißwasser signs illuminate beachside taverns across Ocean Beach, while delivery vans navigate between rural Ambrosia roadhouses. In-game radio commercials feature raucous Bavarian singing and outrageous satirical jingles.
slogan: You're in for a good time!
